session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.title: Plumbing Track implementation ledger — 2026-09-09
session-2026-09-09-plumbing-track.content: Comprehensive final record for the live pt-site-updates implementation session. Scope covered the docs-led homepage rebuild; dedicated Book an Assessment flow; shared header/footer and responsive menu across non-assessment pages; Our Work proof library; gold/navy palette corrections; section sizing; orphan-aware typography; testimonial contrast and author emphasis; card images, shadows, and animation; CTA button geometry, spacing, chevrons, and colors; scroll threshold behavior; Resources menu reduction to FAQ and Client Portal; tablet/mobile no-overflow corrections; and live browser verification. Grapher now includes implementation records, failure/hiccup records, and linked tests for assessment fit, pinned hero behavior, responsive navigation, and global card reveals.

decision-continuous-documentation-graphe.title: Use Grapher continuously for documentation
decision-continuous-documentation-graphe.content: {"decision":"Agents must use Grapher continuously while creating, changing, reorganizing, or interpreting project documentation.","rationale":"Documentation and durable project knowledge must evolve together; a one-time or end-of-session sync can miss decisions, supersession, relationships, and verification state."}

requirement-continuous-documentation-gra.title: Documentation work must stay synchronized with Grapher
requirement-continuous-documentation-gra.content: {"requirement":"Before material documentation edits, agents must search Grapher; during the work they must record durable decisions, requirements, scope changes, relationships, supersession, and verification as they become known; before completion they must validate and audit the graph.","acceptance_condition":"Documentation changes and corresponding Grapher semantic state are updated in the same work cycle; direct hand-editing of Grapher state files is avoided; CI sync is treated as a backstop rather than a substitute for agent semantic capture."}
